name: rx-db-path
check: cd . && python3 -m unittest -q tests/test_db.py && python3 -c "import sys;sys.path.insert(0,'app');import rx_db as d;c=d.connect(':memory:');d.upsert_file(c,{'path':'/m/A/x/1.mkv','library':'A','folder':'x','size':1,'mtime':1.0,'codec':'h264','height':1080,'bitrate_kbps':1,'duration_s':1.0,'status':'pending','reason':None});assert d.folder_files(c,'A','x')[0]['path']=='/m/A/x/1.mkv'"

name: rx-index2
check: cd ./app/static/ && for i in mode pause parallel conn tiles notice space space-fill space-text chart libchart jobs job-list q filter view-grid view-list folders detail detail-title detail-sum detail-close detail-actions compare detail-body detail-json; do grep -q "id=\"$i\"" index.html || echo "error: index.html: missing id $i"; done | tee /dev/stderr | grep -q error && exit 1; grep -q '/static/chart.js' index.html && grep -q '/static/detail.js' index.html && ! sed -n '/<head>/,/<\/head>/p' index.html | grep -q '<picture'

name: rx-chart
check: cd ./app/static/ && node --check chart.js && grep -q 'window.KKChart' chart.js && ! grep -n 'innerHTML *=' chart.js | grep -v "innerHTML *= *''" | grep -q .
